title: Investor Reporting | Lender & LP Portfolio Reporting | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Investor and lender reporting for commercial loan portfolios: disbursement trails, delinquency status, and reconcilable activity that supports LP and examiner review.
h1: Reporting your LPs and examiners can rely on
lede: Institutional capital does not just want a statement — it wants a reconcilable trail. Our reporting is built on the same ledger that runs collection and disbursement.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Reporting is generated from the servicing ledger: loan status, payment activity, delinquency flags, and lender disbursement — reconciled rather than re-keyed.

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Because reporting is produced from the same ledger that runs payments, the numbers reconcile to the underlying transactions rather than to a separately maintained spreadsheet.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: Lenders receive regular portfolio reporting; the transaction trail behind it supports the 'show me' question examiners and LPs ask.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: Reporting that ties to the transaction trail is a diligence asset — it turns an LP or examiner request into a straightforward pull instead of a scramble.

faqs.a: Yes. Reporting is generated from the servicing ledger that runs collection and disbursement, so figures reconcile to the underlying transactions.

faqs.q: Can reporting support an LP or examiner review?
faqs.a: Yes. The underlying, retained transaction trail supports lender, LP, and examiner review on request.

faqs.q: Do you publish portfolio performance statistics on this site?
faqs.a: No. We do not publish assets under management, loan counts, recovery rates, or other performance statistics; reporting is delivered to the lender for their own book.

ctaBody: Request a walkthrough of the reporting pack and the trail behind it.
